title: Ender's Game
description: After an alien invasion, an unlikely recruit commands Earth's forces and fights for the future of humanity.

title: The Arrival
description: Astronomer Zane Zaminsky finds extraterrestrials and conspiracy after tracking strange radio signals to a Mexican village.

title: Kin
description: On the run from a Detroit crime boss, an ex-con and his adopted brother use a high-tech gun to battle an army of thugs and two heavily armored, futuristic soldiers who want their weapon back.

title: Line of Duty
description: A disgraced cop teams up with a livestreaming news broadcaster to try and save the police chief's kidnapped daughter.

title: Patriots Day
description: In the aftermath of the Boston Marathon bombings, police Sgt. Tommy Saunders, FBI Special Agent Richard DesLauriers and Commissioner Ed Davis join survivors, first responders and other investigators in a race against time to find the suspects.

title: Raw Deal
description: A former FBI agent (Arnold Schwarzenegger) infiltrates the biggest mob in Chicago and single-handedly wipes it out.

title: Righteous Kill
description: Two veteran detectives hunt a vigilante whose crimes resemble those of a killer they put behind bars long ago.
